The *Ekaccaṁatthītikathā* (Kv 1.8) is a debate section belonging to the first chapter (*vagga*) of the *Kathāvatthu*, which constitutes the fifth treatise of the canonical Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records one translation in a modern language for this text, though it lists no curated textual parallels [SuttaCentral].

Text-reuse analysis conducted by DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal formulaic reuse, detecting 850 matching passages shared across 19 different Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The highest degree of shared material occurs with closely related ontological and temporal debates within the first chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, specifically the *Atītakkhandhādikathā* (Kv 1.7), the *Sabbamatthītikathā* (Kv 1.6), and the *Hevatthikathā* (Kv 1.10), alongside the foundational *Puggalakathā* (Kv 1.1) [DharmaNexus]. Beyond the *Kathāvatthu*, DharmaNexus registers shared passages with commentary in the *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā* and with the *Uppādanirodhavāra* of the *Yamaka* (Ya 9.2.3) [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language alignment, DharmaNexus matches passages with Sanskrit and Tibetan philosophical treatises, including Kamalaśīla's *Madhyamakāloka*, although these machine-computed alignments reflect structural or thematic text reuse rather than direct historical parallels [DharmaNexus].
